prompt: The star of the TV show "The Bear" had his breakout role on a Showtime show. The actress who played his older sister on that Showtime show released an album in 2007. The label who released her album released their first album 27 years previous. From their first album, what number did the title track reach on the Billboard Hot 100?
answer:
The title track reached **No. 3** on the Billboard Hot 100.

Reasoning: Jeremy Allen White’s breakout role was Lip Gallagher on Showtime’s *Shameless*, alongside Emmy Rossum as his older sister Fiona. Rossum’s 2007 album *Inside Out* was released by Geffen Records, whose first album was Donna Summer’s *The Wanderer* (1980). “The Wanderer” peaked at **No. 3**.
